tools.name: Hunchly
tools.role: Automatic page capture with URLs, timestamps, hashes, case organization, and audit trail.
tools.notes: Best professional browser-capture option. Keep exports in encrypted case storage and verify captures before relying on them.

tools.name: ArchiveBox
tools.role: Self-hosted preservation in durable formats including HTML, screenshots, PDF, WARC, JSON, and text.
tools.notes: Use as an open-source capture backend. Confirm how authenticated/private pages and external archive submissions are configured.

tools.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine / CDX API
tools.role: Discover historical public captures and enumerate capture timestamps through CDX.
tools.notes: Treat an archived page as a dated capture, not proof that content was continuously present or authored by the apparent owner.

tools.name: Common Crawl
tools.role: Large-scale historical web discovery using indexes and WARC/WAT/WET datasets.
tools.notes: Useful when Wayback coverage is missing or bulk historical analysis is justified. Filter narrowly to avoid needless data collection.

tools.name: Joplin
tools.role: Structured Markdown notes with attachments and optional synchronization.
tools.notes: Prefer a local encrypted notebook or approved sync target. The case ledger remains the authoritative source register.

tools.name: Obsidian
tools.role: Local Markdown knowledge base with links, templates, and graph views.
tools.notes: Useful for analysis but avoid uncontrolled plugins in sensitive cases.

tools.name: Flameshot
tools.role: Annotated screenshots for working notes.
tools.notes: A screenshot alone is weak evidence; also log URL, access time, context, and an unannotated capture.

tools.name: SearXNG
tools.role: Self-hosted metasearch with JSON, CSV, and RSS output when enabled.
tools.notes: Respect upstream engine terms and rate limits. Do not assume every engine implements the same operators.

tools.name: Google Search
tools.role: General web, document, news, image, and map discovery with advanced operators.
tools.notes: Record the exact query, date, locale, and relevant result URL; ranking is personalized and changes over time.

tools.name: Microsoft Bing
tools.role: Independent search and visual-search index for corroborating or expanding Google results.
tools.notes: Use multiple indexes because coverage and ranking differ.

tools.name: Brave Search
tools.role: Additional search index with a supported API for programmatic workflows.
tools.notes: Prefer the documented API over scraping result pages.

tools.name: DuckDuckGo
tools.role: Privacy-oriented search interface and an additional result view.
tools.notes: Results may rely on upstream sources; use as one index among several.

tools.name: Yandex Search and Images
tools.role: Alternative regional and visually similar-image discovery.
tools.notes: Use only when policy and jurisdiction permit uploading/querying the subject data; never upload sensitive originals without a data-transfer review.

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.role: Local extraction of EXIF, IPTC, XMP, ICC, C2PA, and many other metadata formats.
tools.notes: Run read-only against a preserved copy; hash the original first and record the command/version.

tools.name: InVID-WeVerify Verification Plugin
tools.role: Video keyframes, reverse search, OCR, metadata, magnification, and verification workflows.
tools.notes: Browser tools may send images or URLs to third parties; assess sensitivity first.

tools.name: Google Lens
tools.role: Reverse and region-based visual search, object/text/landmark discovery, and similar images.
tools.notes: Upload only when third-party processing is appropriate; preserve the query image and result URLs.

tools.name: TinEye
tools.role: Exact and modified-image matching useful for earlier appearances and provenance leads.
tools.notes: No-result does not establish originality. Compare dates and source context manually.

tools.name: FFmpeg / ffprobe
tools.role: Inspect streams and create documented keyframes, audio extracts, and working derivatives.
tools.notes: Never replace the original. Record commands and link every derivative to its source artifact hash.

tools.name: Tesseract OCR
tools.role: Local OCR for images and scanned documents.
tools.notes: OCR output is a derivative and may contain errors; verify critical text against the image.

tools.name: OCRmyPDF
tools.role: Adds searchable OCR text to working copies of scanned PDFs.
tools.notes: Keep and hash the untouched original separately.

tools.name: Google Maps / Google Earth
tools.role: Map, satellite, terrain, streetside, place-photo, distance, and historical-imagery analysis.
tools.notes: Record imagery date and provider; visible imagery may be months or years old.

tools.name: OpenStreetMap / Overpass
tools.role: Searchable global map data and feature queries for roads, businesses, infrastructure, and boundaries.
tools.notes: Community data varies in freshness and completeness; corroborate important features.

tools.name: Mapillary
tools.role: Crowdsourced geotagged street-level imagery that can fill coverage gaps.
tools.notes: Check capture date, sequence, contributor context, and licensing.

tools.name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
tools.role: Search and compare dated Earth-observation imagery and spectral products.
tools.notes: Resolution, cloud cover, processing, and acquisition time constrain conclusions.

tools.name: SunCalc
tools.role: Sun position and shadow plausibility checks for candidate place/date/time combinations.
tools.notes: Use as corroboration with camera geometry, weather, and scene features, not as a single proof.

tools.name: QGIS
tools.role: Spatial analysis, layer comparison, geocoding outputs, and publication-quality maps.
tools.notes: Track layer source, license, coordinate reference system, and access date.

tools.name: WhatsMyName
tools.role: Community-maintained account-check definitions and manual public username search.
tools.notes: Open every result and verify it. A found handle is not proof of ownership or identity.

tools.name: Sherlock
tools.role: Automated username checks across hundreds of public networks with export formats.
tools.notes: Use scoped site lists, conservative timeouts, and manual validation; stop on rate-limit or block signals.

tools.name: Maigret
tools.role: Broad username discovery, metadata extraction, recursive pivots, and graph/report output.
tools.notes: Its breadth increases false-positive, ToS, and rate-limit risk. Disable recursive or broad checks unless justified.

tools.name: Hunter
tools.role: Public organizational email discovery, pattern identification, sources, and verification.
tools.notes: Use for legitimate organizational research and outreach; verify source and role before attributing an address to a person.

tools.name: Have I Been Pwned
tools.role: Breach metadata checks for self-owned or authorized addresses and verified organizational domains.
tools.notes: The toolbox does not retrieve or store passwords. Follow HIBP terms, attribution, privacy, verification, and rate-limit requirements.

tools.name: ICANN RDAP Lookup
tools.role: Structured current domain registration data through RDAP, the replacement for most WHOIS use.
tools.notes: Privacy laws and registrar policies limit returned fields. Record the authoritative RDAP server and query time.

tools.name: SecurityTrails DNS History
tools.role: Retrieve provider-observed historical A, AAAA, MX, NS, SOA, and TXT record sets by hostname.
tools.notes: Requires an approved account and API key. Coverage and retention depend on the plan; a historical association is not proof of current control.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.role: Certificate-transparency search for hostnames, certificates, issuers, and dates.
tools.notes: A certificate name is evidence of issuance/observation, not proof that a host is live or currently controlled by the subject.

tools.name: urlscan.io
tools.role: Search historical public web scans, hostnames, domains, requests, certificates, and screenshots.
tools.notes: Search existing scans by default. Never submit a confidential or sensitive URL as a public scan; use private visibility if licensed and authorized.

tools.name: Censys Platform
tools.role: Passive search across hosts, web properties, services, and certificates with current/historical context.
tools.notes: Use only for scoped passive observation. Shared infrastructure and stale observations require ownership verification.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.role: Search previously observed internet-exposed services and banners.
tools.notes: Do not connect to or test discovered services without separate authorization; banners may be stale or deceptive.

tools.name: SpiderFoot
tools.role: Modular OSINT automation and relationship discovery across many public data sources.
tools.notes: Create passive-only scan profiles, inspect module behavior, secure the local UI, and configure API keys deliberately.

tools.name: Maltego Graph
tools.role: Entity/relationship analysis with transforms, machines, connectors, and visual graphs.
tools.notes: Use transforms as collection leads, retain underlying source URLs, and do not let graph proximity imply a relationship.

tools.name: Gephi
tools.role: Large network visualization and exploratory graph analysis from exported nodes and edges.
tools.notes: Keep evidence and inference edge types separate; graph metrics can be misleading on incomplete collections.

tools.name: OpenCorporates
tools.role: Cross-jurisdiction company discovery with links back to primary public registers.
tools.notes: Use it to locate records, then verify material facts at the cited official registry. Observe licensing and API limits.

tools.name: GLEIF LEI Search / API
tools.role: Legal Entity Identifier records, parent relationships, registered names, and reference data.
tools.notes: Coverage is strongest for entities participating in financial transactions; absence is not evidence that an entity does not exist.

tools.name: SEC EDGAR
tools.role: US issuer submissions, filing histories, and structured XBRL facts without an API key.
tools.notes: Follow SEC fair-access policy and identify the requesting application.

tools.name: UK Companies House
tools.role: Official UK company profiles, officers, filings, charges, and insolvency data.
tools.notes: Use the official register for UK entities and preserve filing dates and document identifiers.

tools.name: OCCRP Aleph
tools.role: Cross-dataset search and entity/document exploration for investigative research.
tools.notes: Dataset inclusion and entity matching are leads; verify against original records. Some datasets require access approval.

tools.name: Native platform search and approved APIs
tools.role: First-party public profile, post, keyword, date, and interaction discovery where the platform permits it.
tools.notes: The transcript's third-party Twitter/Instagram tools are volatile. Prefer native search and documented APIs, and capture source context.

tools.name: KeepNote (course-era)
tools.role: Hierarchical note taking demonstrated in the transcript.
tools.notes: Replace with Joplin, Obsidian, or an approved case-management system; do not base a new workflow on unmaintained software.

tools.name: Fake identity and AI-face generators (course-era)
tools.role: The transcript used these to build sock-puppet personas.
tools.notes: Not part of the default package. Use dedicated research accounts only under policy, platform terms, and explicit authority; do not impersonate a real person or deceptively engage targets.

tools.name: Clearbit Connect (course-era)
tools.role: Email discovery extension demonstrated in the transcript.
tools.notes: Do not depend on this legacy workflow. Use current licensed providers, first-party sources, and a provider adapter.

tools.name: Leaked-password databases and hash cracking (course-era)
tools.role: The transcript demonstrated DeHashed-like databases, password reuse pivots, and hash lookup.
tools.notes: The package keeps only lawful exposure metadata through HIBP or an approved enterprise service. It excludes leaked password collection, cracking, stuffing, and spraying.

tools.name: People-search/data-broker sites (course-era)
tools.role: The transcript used US-centric people, address, phone, and voter-record aggregators.
tools.notes: Use only when lawful, necessary, and in scope. Treat results as unverified leads, prefer official jurisdictional records, and minimize sensitive personal data.

tools.name: SocialBearing, Sleeping Time, Mentionmapp, TweetBeaver, Spoonbill, Tinfoleak (course-era)
tools.role: Profile analytics, interaction mapping, history, stable IDs, and monitoring demonstrated in the transcript.
tools.notes: Treat as historical examples. Recreate the methods through native search, approved APIs, archived pages, and source-preserving analysis.

tools.name: TweetDeck / X Pro (course-era workflow)
tools.role: Column-based real-time monitoring of users, keywords, lists, and searches.
tools.notes: The product and access model changed. Use only under current X terms and do not infer real-time location from weak signals.

tools.name: Third-party Instagram viewers/downloaders (course-era)
tools.role: Profile-image and post downloading demonstrated through several transient websites.
tools.notes: Exclude brittle, ad-heavy, or credential-seeking services. Use public first-party views/APIs and evidence capture permitted by policy.
